The Telangana State Level Police Recruitment Board (TSLPRB), now functioning as the Telangana Police Recruitment Board (TGPRB), announced the TGSRTC Driver & Shramik Final Result 2026 on 3 August 2026. The result covers the recruitment drive for Driver and Shramik posts in the Telangana State Road Transport Corporation (TGSRTC, formerly TSRTC). A total of 1,604 candidates have been selected out of 1,743 advertised vacancies. This article explains the result, selection numbers, next steps, and required documents based on official announcements.

The recruitment was originally notified for 1,743 posts. Following the written exam, driving test, and verification stages, the final selection numbers are as follows.

Driving test mark sheets for Driver-post candidates have been made available in individual candidate logins on the official website.

Also Read: AFCAT 2 Admit Card 2026

Required Documents for Attestation and Verification

  • Printed and signed online attestation form (3 copies)
  • Educational qualification certificates (SSC/ITI as applicable)
  • Community/caste certificate in the prescribed format, where applicable
  • Local/residence certificate
  • Date of birth proof
  • Recent passport-size photographs
  • Valid driving licence (for Driver post candidates)
  • Any other certificate specified in the individual candidate's admit card or selection intimation

Candidates should verify the exact document checklist from their official login, as requirements can vary slightly by post and category.

How to Check TGSRTC Driver & Shramik Result 2026

  1. Visit the official website of TGPRB (TSLPRB) at tgprb.in.
  2. Look for the link related to "TGSRTC Driver & Shramik Final Result 2026" on the homepage or notifications section.
  3. Log in using your registered credentials (hall ticket number/registration number and password) where required.
  4. Check your selection status, and for Driver-post candidates, view the driving test mark sheet.
  5. Download and save a copy of the result and any mark sheet for future reference.

Also Read: MPPSC SSE Mains Admit Card 2026

What Happens Next After the Result

Selection in the final list is not the same as a confirmed job offer. According to the board, final appointment depends on character and antecedent verification and qualifying in the medical examination. Selected candidates must complete the online attestation form and submit certificates at their respective police district or commissionerate office as per the schedule below.

  • Step 1: Fill the online attestation form between 8:00 AM on 7 August 2026 and midnight on 11 August 2026.
  • Step 2: Take three printed copies of the filled attestation form.
  • Step 3: Submit the attestation forms along with original and photocopies of relevant certificates at the respective police district or commissionerate office on 17 August 2026.
  • Step 4: Await confirmation after character/antecedent verification and medical examination.

Important Instructions

  • Selected candidates are advised to check the official website immediately to verify their details in the selection list.
  • Carry original certificates along with photocopies at the time of document submission; incomplete documentation may affect the verification outcome.
  • Keep track of both the attestation form window and the physical submission date, as these are separate steps with different deadlines.
  • Regularly check the official TGPRB website for any further updates, corrigenda, or category-wise cutoff changes.
  • The specific helpline number or email ID for the Driver & Shramik result query was not confirmed in the sources used for this article; candidates should refer to the contact details published on the official TGPRB website.

Click Here: RBI Grade B (DEPR) Result 2026

RBI Grade B DEPR Result 2026 - Quick Overview

This section summarizes the core details of the result announcement so you can quickly confirm what has been released and what stage you're at in the recruitment process.

The result pertains to Officers in Grade 'B' (DR) – DEPR Cadre, published under Advt. No. RBISB/DA/01/2026-27 dated April 29, 2026. It marks the completion of Phase-I and the start of the Phase-II selection stage.

Phase-II Exam Date (DEPR) 26 July 2026
Number of Shifts (Phase-II) 2 (Shift 1 and Shift 2)
Admit Card Single admit card for both shifts
Official Website rbi.org.in

How to Check Your RBI Grade B DEPR Phase-I Result

This section explains the exact process for confirming your roll number in the official result document, so you know where to look and what to avoid.

The result has been published as a roll-number list within an official PDF on the RBI website. Rather than depending on third-party lists, always verify your own status directly.

  • Visit the official RBI website: www.rbi.org.in, or the Opportunities@RBI recruitment portal.
  • Open the official Phase-I DEPR Result PDF for the roll number list.
  • Use Ctrl+F (or Cmd+F) on the PDF and search for your own roll number.
  • Save or download the PDF for your future reference.

RBI has also noted a standard disclaimer with this result: despite careful preparation, the Board reserves the right to correct any inadvertent errors. If you spot a discrepancy in your details, wait for an official corrigendum rather than relying on unverified sources.

RBI Grade B DEPR Eligibility Criteria

This section outlines the qualification requirement specific to the DEPR cadre, useful for candidates confirming they meet the criteria before Phase-II.

Candidates applying for the DEPR cadre must possess a Master's Degree in Economics, or a Master's Degree in Finance/PGDM/MBA from a recognized university or institution.

RBI Grade B DEPR Phase-II Exam 2026: Key Details

This section explains what to expect in the Phase-II stage, including the exam date, shift structure, and admit card rules points candidates often get confused about.

Phase-II for the DEPR cadre is scheduled for July 26, 2026, and will be conducted in two shifts on the same day. A few important points to note:

  • One exam, two shifts: Candidates must appear for all papers across both shifts attending only one shift is not allowed.
  • Single admit card: RBI will issue only one admit card covering both shifts, unlike exams that issue separate call letters per shift.
  • No logistical flexibility: No request for change of exam date, shift, centre, or venue will be entertained under any circumstance. Plan your travel and stay in advance once your centre is confirmed.

How to Download the RBI Grade B Phase-II Admit Card

This section provides the step-by-step process to download your Phase-II admit card once RBI activates the link.

  1. Visit the official RBI website: www.rbi.org.in.
  2. Locate the Phase-II admit card link under the careers/recruitment section.
  3. Log in using your registration number and password/date of birth.
  4. Download the admit card and verify your exam date, shift timing, and venue carefully.
  5. Along with the admit card, RBI will also release an Information Handout for Phase-II, plus separate instructions for PwBD candidates using a scribe or compensatory time, and for candidates with specified disability (less than 40%) who have difficulty writing.

RBI Grade B Selection Process

This section explains the overall stages of selection for the Officer Grade B recruitment, as outlined in the official notification.

According to the official recruitment details, the selection process comprises:

  • Online Examination (CBT) Phase-I and Phase-II
  • Language Proficiency Test (LPT)
  • Final Merit List

How to Check SBI CBO Result 2026 (Step-by-Step)

The final merit list is prepared based on combined performance in the online examination and interview, with a reported weightage split of 75:25 (online test : interview), and the interview itself carries 50 marks.

Since the interview is the immediate next step for shortlisted candidates, here's what is currently known about its schedule.

Reports indicate the SBI CBO interview round is scheduled for mid-July 2026, with different sources citing dates of 13 July and 14 July 2026. As this detail is subject to confirmation, candidates should wait for the official interview call letter on the SBI careers portal for their exact date, time, and venue rather than relying on any single unconfirmed date.

How Is the SBI CBO Merit Calculated?

Understanding the marking scheme helps candidates interpret their own performance realistically before the scorecard is released.

The SBI CBO written exam follows a standard negative marking pattern:

Final Marks = (Correct Answers × 1) - (Wrong Answers × 0.25)

Important Instructions for AFCAT 2 Admit Card 2026

  • Keep your registration number, Email ID, and password ready before logging in.
  • Cross-check your name, photograph, exam centre, and roll number immediately after downloading.
  • Report to the exam centre well before the reporting time entry is typically not allowed once the pre-exam verification process begins.
  • If any detail on the admit card is incorrect, contact the AFCAT authorities immediately through the official helpdesk/contact details listed on the portal to get it corrected before exam day.

AFCAT 2 2026 Selection Process

Candidates who apply through the standard AFCAT entry must clear the following stages in order:

  1. AFCAT Written Examination - an online objective test covering General Awareness, Verbal Ability in English, Numerical Ability, Reasoning, and Military Aptitude.
  2. AFSB Testing (Stage 1 and Stage 2) - includes the Officer Intelligence Rating (OIR) test, Picture Perception and Discussion Test (PPDT), psychological tests, group tasks, and a personal interview.
  3. Medical Examination - conducted by an Air Force medical board as per prescribed standards.

Candidates applying through NCC Special Entry or GATE Score Entry are exempted from the written exam and proceed directly to the AFSB stage, as per the official notification.

As per the notice, the SBI CBO interview will be held from 13 July 2026 to 19 July 2026. If you're one of the shortlisted candidates, this is your final step before securing a role as a Circle Based Officer at SBI so let's walk through everything you need to know: where to download the call letter, what documents to carry, and how the final selection is calculated.

What Is the SBI CBO Interview Call Letter 2026?

Before downloading your admit card, it helps to understand exactly what this document is and why it matters for the recruitment process. The SBI CBO Interview Call Letter is the official admission ticket that confirms a candidate has cleared the earlier stages and is now eligible to appear for the personal interview round.

The interview call letter is a mandatory document for the SBI CBO Recruitment 2026 drive, which is being conducted to fill 2,050 vacancies for the Circle Based Officer post across various states and language zones. Without this call letter, candidates will not be permitted entry into the interview venue, so downloading and verifying it well in advance is essential.

Login Credentials Required to Download the Call Letter

  • Registration Number or Roll Number (generated at the time of application/exam)
  • Password or Date of Birth (as set/used during registration)

Since these credentials were generated earlier in the recruitment cycle, candidates who have misplaced them should retrieve their registration details before the download window gets busy closer to the interview dates.

If you're downloading your call letter for the first time, this simple step-by-step guide will help you complete the process without errors.

  1. Visit the official SBI website or the direct download link provided above.
  2. Navigate to the "Careers" section (if accessing via sbi.co.in).

  • Candidate's name and roll number
  • Interview date and reporting time
  • Interview venue name and complete address

Documents to Carry for the SBI CBO Interview 2026

Carrying the correct set of documents is non-negotiable for interview-day entry. This section lists everything you must bring along.

  • A printed copy of the interview call letter
  • A valid original photo ID proof (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, Voter ID, etc.)
  • Original and photocopies of educational certificates and mark sheets
  • Recent passport-size photographs (the same one used during application, if specified)

Candidates should keep all documents organized in a single folder to avoid last-minute confusion at the venue.

SBI CBO 2026 Selection Process Explained

Understanding how your final selection is calculated helps you prepare strategically for the interview. This section explains the complete selection methodology for SBI CBO 2026.

The SBI Circle Based Officer recruitment follows a multi-stage selection process:

  1. Online Examination - The first screening stage testing candidates' aptitude and knowledge.
  2. Screening/Shortlisting - Candidates are shortlisted based on online exam performance for the interview stage.
  3. Interview - Worth 50 marks, assessing banking awareness, professional knowledge, and communication skills.
  4. Local Language Proficiency Test - Candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the regional/local language relevant to their applied state or circle.

How Is the Final Merit List Prepared?

The final selection isn't based on the interview alone it combines scores from multiple stages using a fixed weightage formula.

The final merit list for SBI CBO 2026 is prepared using combined weightage:

  • Online Examination: 75% weightage
  • Interview: 25% weightage

This means strong performance in the online exam significantly boosts your overall chances, but a good interview score remains essential for the final cutoff.

SBI CBO Salary and Pay Scale 2026

Selected Circle Based Officers will receive a starting basic pay of ₹48,480, along with 2 advance increments, as per the official SBI CBO notification. For a full salary breakup including allowances and in-hand pay, refer to the SBI CBO Salary details.

The Central Bank of India Apprentice Exam 2026 is scheduled for 5th July 2026 (Sunday) and will be conducted by BFSI SSC in online computer-based test mode. This article explains the admit card release details, exam date, download steps, eligibility, exam pattern, and everything else candidates need before exam day.

Candidates should keep checking the official website for updates regarding the Local Language Proficiency Test schedule, which is typically announced after the online exam result.

CBI Apprentice Vacancy Details 2026

The Central Bank of India has announced a total of 4,500 Apprentice vacancies for the financial year 2026-27, distributed across various states and union territories. Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh reportedly have the largest state-wise allocations. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification PDF on the bank's recruitment page for the exact state-wise and category-wise vacancy breakup, since detailed figures for every state were not confirmed in the sources reviewed for this article.

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must meet the educational qualification, age limit, and nationality conditions set by the Central Bank of India to be eligible for the Apprentice post.

Educational Qualification

  • A graduation degree (bachelor's degree) in any discipline from a recognised university or institute.
  • Candidates should have completed graduation on or after 1 January 2022 (some sources indicate the cut-off as 1 January 2021; candidates should verify the exact date on the official notification).
  • Candidates with one year or more of work or training experience after graduation are not eligible, since this scheme is meant for fresh graduates.
  • Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship training, or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training elsewhere, are not eligible.
  • Basic computer knowledge is required.
  • Candidates must be proficient in the local language of the state they are applying for.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 20 and 28 years of age as on 31 May 2026, meaning they should be born between 31 May 1998 and 31 May 2006 (both dates inclusive).

Category Age Relaxation
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years
SC / ST 5 years
PwBD (UR/EWS) 10 years

PwBD (SC/ST) 15 years

Candidates should check the official notification for the exact category-wise age relaxation applicable to them.

Salary / Stipend Details

Selected apprentices will receive a fixed monthly stipend of ₹15,000 during the 12-month training period. This is a training stipend rather than a regular salary, and no other allowances or benefits are provided. Completion of the apprenticeship does not guarantee permanent employment with the bank.

Application Fee

The exact application fee amount for the CBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 was not confirmed in the sources reviewed for this article. Candidates should refer to the official Central Bank of India Apprentice notification PDF on centralbank.bank.in for accurate, category-wise fee details, since this cannot be reliably stated here.

Selection Process

The Central Bank of India Apprentice selection process involves two stages:

  1. Online Written Examination: An objective-type computer-based test with no negative marking for wrong answers.
  2. Local Language Proficiency Test: Candidates who qualify the online exam may need to appear for a test assessing reading, writing, and speaking skills in the local language of the applied state. Candidates who studied the local language at Class 10 or Class 12 level may be exempted from this test, subject to document verification.

Final selection also depends on document verification and meeting the required medical fitness standards set by the bank.

Documents Required at the Exam Centre

  • Printed copy of the CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026
  • A valid original government-issued photo ID proof, such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, Voter ID, or Driving Licence
  • A photocopy of the photo ID for verification
  • Recent passport-size photographs, as specified in the admit card instructions

Candidates should ensure the name on their ID proof matches the name printed on the admit card to avoid denial of entry.

How to Download the CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026

Follow these steps to download your Central Bank of India Apprentice hall ticket:

  1. Visit the official website of the Central Bank of India at centralbankofindia.co.in or centralbank.bank.in.
  2. Go to the "Recruitment" or "Careers" section on the homepage.
  3. Click on the "CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026" or "Download Call Letter" link.
  4. Enter your Registration Number/Roll Number and Password or Date of Birth.
  5. Fill in the captcha code, if required.
  6. Click the Login or Submit button.
  7. Your CBI Apprentice Hall Ticket 2026 will appear on the screen.
  8. Carefully verify all details, including your name, photograph, signature, exam date, and exam centre.
  9. Download the admit card and take a clear printout on an A4 sheet for the examination.

Central Bank of India Apprentice Exam Pattern 2026

The online written examination consists of 100 objective-type questions worth 100 marks, to be completed in 60 minutes, with no negative marking.

  • Carry the printed admit card; digital copies on a phone or tablet are typically not accepted.
  • Do not carry prohibited items such as mobile phones, smartwatches, calculators, Bluetooth devices, bags, or study material into the exam hall.
  • Check your name, photograph, exam centre address, and category details on the admit card, and report any discrepancy to the helpdesk immediately.

Documents to Carry to the RBI Grade B Exam Centre

Carrying the right documents to the examination centre is mandatory. Entry will not be granted if the candidate fails to produce valid identity proof along with the printed admit card.

Every candidate must bring the following on exam day:

Printed copy of the RBI Grade B Admit Card 2026, 2 recent passport-size photographs, one valid original Photo ID proof such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, Voter ID, or Driving Licence, and a photocopy of the same Photo ID.

RBI Grade B Exam Pattern 2026

Understanding the exam pattern helps candidates prepare effectively for both phases of the selection process. The RBI Grade B selection consists of Phase 1 (Prelims), Phase 2 (Mains), and an Interview round.

Phase 1 Exam Pattern - Objective Type (Qualifying)

Phase 1 is a 2-hour online objective exam carrying 200 marks across 200 questions. Since it is only qualifying, candidates must clear it to advance to Mains, but these marks do not count toward the final score.

RBI Grade B Exam Day Instructions 2026

RBI has issued specific instructions that every candidate must follow on exam day. Non-compliance may result in disqualification from the examination.

Candidates must reach the exam centre before the gate closing time without fail. Biometric verification including thumb impression and photograph capture will be conducted at the centre. Ensure your name on the admit card matches exactly with your photo ID. Wearing clothes with metal items, large buttons, or accessories that could trigger security checks should be avoided. Electronic devices including mobile phones, smart watches, Bluetooth devices, calculators, and books are strictly prohibited inside the examination hall. The exam centre and date allotted on the call letter are final no requests for change of centre, date, or session will be entertained.

Click Here: RBI Grade B Phase 1 Exam Pattern 2026

RBI Grade B 2026 - Selection Process

The RBI Grade B 2026 selection process consists of three stages. Candidates must clear each stage to progress to the next:

  1. Phase 1 - Preliminary Exam (Qualifying) - Online objective CBT | 200 marks | 120 minutes | Negative marking of 0.25 per wrong answer | Qualifying nature only
  2. Phase 2 - Main Exam (Merit-Based) - Objective + Descriptive papers | Papers on Economic & Social Issues (ESI), Finance & Management (F&M), and English | Specialised papers for DEPR/DSIM streams
  3. Phase 3 - Interview - 75 marks | Candidates appear for a Psychometric Test before the interview | Final merit based on Phase 2 + Interview marks

RBI Grade B 2026 - Salary & Perks

Pay Component Amount
Basic Pay ₹78,450 per month
Gross Monthly Salary (incl. all allowances) ₹1,54,936 per month
Additional Benefits HRA, Medical Coverage, Pension, Travel Allowance, Concessional Housing Loan, Staff Welfare facilities

Documents to Carry Along with RBI Grade B Hall Ticket 2026

On the day of the RBI Grade B Phase 1 examination 2026, candidates must carry the following documents to the exam centre. Keep them ready 2-3 days before the exam:

  • Printout of the RBI Grade B Phase 1 Call Letter 2026 (colour printout preferred)
  • Valid government-issued Photo ID (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Driving Licence, PAN Card, Passport)
  • Passport-sized Photograph (same as uploaded in the application form)

Documents NOT to Carry on RBI Grade B Exam Day 2026

The following items are strictly prohibited inside RBI Grade B 2026 examination centres:

  • Textbooks, notebooks, or any printed/handwritten study material
  • Mobile phones, smartwatches, or fitness bands
  • Bluetooth devices or wireless earphones
  • Calculators or digital watches
  • Electronic gadgets of any kind
  • Bags, purses, or wallets
  • Geometry boxes, pencil boxes, or pouches

📄 Complete Details & Notification

The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the notification for CRP CSA-XVI, the 16th Common Recruitment Process for Customer Service Associate (CSA) posts - popularly known as IBPS Clerk Recruitment - in 11 participating Public Sector Banks. The vacancies are for the financial year 2027-28, and online registration opens on 01.08.2026.

Quick answer: IBPS is recruiting for the Customer Service Associate (Clerk) post under CRP CSA-XVI, with indicative state-wise vacancies across 11 public sector banks (not less than 11,403 posts based on the state totals in the notification, though this figure is not stated as a national total in the notification itself - see the Vacancy Details section below). Graduates aged 20–28 years (as on 01.08.2026) can apply. Online registration runs from 01.08.2026 to 21.08.2026, applications are submitted only through the official IBPS website www.ibps.in, and posting is anywhere in India depending on the State/UT a candidate applies for.

IBPS Clerk (CRP CSA-XVI) Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF Out

IBPS has published the detailed notification for CRP CSA-XVI on its official website. Candidates should read the full notification carefully before applying, since it contains state-wise vacancy breakups, reservation details, and document requirements.

  • IBPS Clerk (CRP CSA-XVI) Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF: Download Here
  • Apply Online Link: Apply Here
  • Official Website: www.ibps.in
  • Grievance Portal: cgrs.ibps.in

IBPS Clerk Recruitment 2026 Overview

Here is a quick snapshot of the IBPS CRP CSA-XVI recruitment before you go through the detailed sections.

IBPS Clerk Vacancy 2026 - Post Details

IBPS has indicated state-wise and category-wise vacancies for the Customer Service Associate post across 11 participating banks in Annexure-I of the notification. The vacancies are described as indicative and anticipated, and the final numbers depend on actual requirements reported by the participating banks closer to the provisional allotment stage. Adding up all the state totals gives approximately 11,403 posts - this is a figure computed by summing the notification's own tables, not a number stated directly in the notification, and it excludes any vacancies from Union Bank of India since those are marked "Not Reported."

IBPS Clerk Eligibility Criteria

The eligibility conditions below are the basic criteria for applying. IBPS clarifies that qualifying in the CRP and being provisionally allotted to a bank does not guarantee employment - the concerned bank retains the final say on appointment.

Criteria Details
Nationality Citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 01.01.1962, or a person of Indian origin migrated from specified countries with an eligibility certificate from the Government of India
Age (as on 01.08.2026) Minimum 20 years, Maximum 28 years (born not earlier than 02.08.1998 and not later than 01.08.2006)
Educational Qualification (as on 21.08.2026) A Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a University recognised by the Government of India, or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Central Government
Local Language Proficiency Candidates must be proficient in reading, writing, speaking and understanding the specified/opted local language of the State/UT they apply for (see Local Language Proficiency Test section)
Computer Literacy Mandatory - a Certificate/Diploma/Degree in computer operations, or having studied Computer/IT as a subject in High School/College

IBPS Clerk Qualification for Ex-Servicemen

Ex-Servicemen who do not hold the above civil qualification are eligible if they are matriculate Ex-Servicemen who obtained the Army Special Certificate of Education (or the equivalent Navy/Air Force certificate) after completing at least 15 years of service in the Armed Forces, with the certificate dated on or before 21.08.2026.

IBPS Clerk Age Limit

The standard age limit is 20 to 28 years as on 01.08.2026. Relaxation in the upper age limit is available to reserved categories as follows:

Category Age Relaxation
Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe 5 years
Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities 10 years
Ex-Servicemen/Disabled Ex-Servicemen Actual period of service in defence forces + 3 years (8 years for Disabled Ex-Servicemen belonging to SC/ST), subject to a maximum age of 50 years
Widows, divorced women, and women legally separated (not remarried) Age concession up to 35 years for General/EWS, 38 years for OBC, 40 years for SC/ST

Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates is available cumulatively with only one of the other relaxation categories listed above (Point II 3 to 5 of the notification), not with more than one.

IBPS Clerk Application Fee

The application fee (inclusive of GST) must be paid online between 01.08.2026 and 21.08.2026:

  • SC/ST/PwBD/ESM/DESM candidates: ₹175
  • All other candidates: ₹850

Bank transaction charges for online payment are to be borne by the candidate. Payment can be made via Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets, or UPI. A correction fee of ₹200 (inclusive of GST) applies if a candidate uses the Edit Window to modify the submitted application.

IBPS Clerk Salary

The Customer Service Associate post carries the following basic pay scale, plus allowances and perquisites as applicable in the allotted participating bank:

The Customer Service Associate is eligible for allowances and perquisites as per the rules of the participating bank in force from time to time. Exact take-home pay after allowances is not specified in the notification, since it varies bank to bank.

IBPS Clerk Selection Process

Selection for CRP CSA-XVI is a two-tier process consisting of an Online Preliminary Examination and an Online Main Examination, followed by a qualifying Local Language Proficiency Test before joining.

Preliminary Examination (Objective Test)

Shortlisted candidates are provisionally allotted to one of the participating banks based on merit-cum-preference and State/UT-wise vacancies reported to IBPS. A reserve list of approximately 30% of vacancies in each category may also be maintained, though this does not guarantee eventual allotment. Eligibility Criteria for CSC Aadhaar Operator Recruitment 2026

Candidates planning to apply for the CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Bharti 2026 must meet all eligibility conditions set by CSC e-Governance Services India Ltd. Mandatory Certificate Requirement

Every applicant must possess an Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate issued by a Testing & Certifying Agency authorized by UIDAI for delivering Aadhaar services. Additionally, candidates must have basic computer skills. Candidates who do not yet hold this certificate can appear for the Aadhaar Supervisor exam through the link: https://uidai.dexitglobalexams.com/UIDAI/LoginAction.action

Salary / Remuneration - CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator 2026

Selected candidates under the CSC Aadhaar Operator Recruitment 2026 will be paid as per the state government's prescribed wage structure. The remuneration for all selected Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator candidates will be the minimum wages of the respective state set for semi-skilled manpower. The exact figure will vary from state to state based on the applicable minimum wage notification of Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, or Maharashtra.

How to Obtain the Aadhaar Supervisor Certificate Before Applying

Candidates who do not yet hold the mandatory Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate need to complete two steps before they are eligible to apply for CSC Aadhaar Seva Kendra jobs. First, they must apply for and pass the Aadhaar Supervisor exam; second, they must complete the LMS certification. Both processes are managed through official UIDAI platforms.

  1. Visit the Aadhaar Supervisor exam portal at https://uidai.dexitglobalexams.com/UIDAI/LoginAction.action and submit your exam application.
  2. An authorization request will be sent to the State Team. Once approved, you will be permitted to appear for the Aadhaar Supervisor exam.
  3. After your LMS ID and Password are created and approved, appear for the Aadhaar LMS Certification through the portal at https://e-learning.uidai.gov.in
  4. Once certified, proceed to apply for the CSC Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor district post on the CSC Job Portal.

The last date to apply is 20 August 2026, and no offline applications are accepted under this recruitment.

  1. Visit the official CSC Job Portal at career.csccloud.in.
  2. Navigate to the relevant job post for your state - Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, or Maharashtra.
  3. Click on the "Apply Now" button on the job post page.
  4. Fill in the online application form with your personal, educational, and certification details.
  5. Upload the required documents including your Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate.
  6. Submit the application form before 20 August 2026.

Common Mistakes to Avoid in CSC Aadhaar Operator Recruitment 2026

Many candidates make avoidable errors while applying for the CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Vacancy 2026 that can lead to rejection of their application. The points below are based on common patterns seen in similar contractual government recruitment drives and are not derived from the official notification.

  1. Applying without a valid UIDAI certificate: The Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate from a UIDAI-authorized agency is a mandatory requirement. Applying without it will result in disqualification.
  2. VLEs applying despite ineligibility: VLEs are explicitly barred from applying. Submitting an application as a VLE wastes your time and will be rejected at the verification stage.
  3. Applying for the wrong district: Each vacancy is district-specific. Ensure you apply for the correct district as per your location and preference.
  4. Incomplete LMS Certification: Candidates sometimes have the Supervisor exam cleared but not the LMS Certification. Both are required before applying.
  5. Submitting incorrect documents: Upload clear, legible scans of your educational certificates and Aadhaar Operator certificate. Blurry or mismatched documents can cause rejection.
  6. Missing the last date: The portal closes applications on 20 August 2026. Do not wait until the last day — technical issues near the deadline are common.
  7. Confusing CSC e-Governance with state government jobs: This is a contractual, not permanent government post. Ensure you understand the terms of engagement before applying.

Assistant / UDC (Post 1, 3 & 5) A: General English, B: Quantitative Aptitude, C: General Intelligence & Reasoning, D: General Knowledge 50 Q / 50 Marks each (200 total) 150 minutes 50% (UR), 40% (Reserved categories against notified reserved vacancies)
JPA / Stenographer (Post 2, 4 & 6) A: English Language & Comprehension, B: General Intelligence & Reasoning, C: Quantitative Aptitude & General Knowledge A: 100 Q/100 Marks, B: 50 Q/50 Marks, C: 50 Q/50 Marks (200 total) 150 minutes 50% (UR), 40% (Reserved categories against notified reserved vacancies)

Marking pattern: +1 for correct answer, -0.25 for wrong answer. No TA is paid for attending the written test.

Skill Test

Based on written test performance, candidates are shortlisted for the skill test in the ratio of 1:5 (maximum) to the category-wise number of vacancies.

Post Skill Test Components Passing Criteria
Assistant / UDC Computer Literacy Test (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint) 60% (UR), 50% (Reserved categories)
JPA / Stenographer Computer Literacy Test + Stenography Test (300 words @ 60 wpm shorthand, 30 minutes computer transcription) Computer Literacy: 60% (UR) / 50% (Reserved); Stenography: max 10% mistakes (UR) / max 12% mistakes (Reserved)

Final selection is based on marks scored in the written test, from among candidates who qualify in the skill test. In case of a tie, tie-breakers are applied in order: (a) marks in General Intelligence & Reasoning (Post 1,3,5) or English Language & Comprehension (Post 2,4,6); (b) date of birth, with the older candidate preferred.

ISRO ICRB Last Date to Apply Online

  • The online application process for ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 started on 27 July 2026 at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 16 August 2026 at 11:55 PM.
  • Candidates who meet the prescribed eligibility criteria are advised to complete the registration process well before the last date to avoid last-minute technical issues.
  • Applications are accepted online only through the official ISRO website. Applicants should ensure that all required documents, including their photograph, signature, and applicable certificates, are uploaded correctly before submitting the application.
  • The application fee must also be paid online on or before 16 August 2026 for the application to be considered complete.

Direct Link to Apply Online for ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026

ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 How to Apply

  • Applications are accepted online only, through the ISRO website, between 27-07-2026 (10:00 AM) and 16-08-2026 (11:55 PM).
  • Candidates may apply for more than one post, subject to conditions. A candidate may apply for different posts under the same or different zones but cannot apply for the same post in different zones. Candidates applying for multiple posts must select the same written test centre.
  • Email ID and mobile number are mandatory in the online application; all hall tickets, call letters, and communications will be sent only via registered email/SMS, with no hard copies sent separately.
  • Candidates registered under the National Career Services (NCS) portal and meeting eligibility conditions may follow the same application process on the ISRO website.
  • Candidates must upload a recent colour passport-size photograph (not older than 6 months, .jpg/.jpeg, 20–50 KB, 200x230 pixels preferred) and signature (.jpg/.jpeg, 10–20 KB, 140x60 pixels preferred), along with SC/ST/Disability/Ex-servicemen certificates where applicable.
  • Applications not conforming to the notified requirements, or incomplete applications, will not be considered.

ISRO ICRB Recruitment 2026 Remuneration

  • Selected candidates will be appointed as Assistant / Junior Personal Assistant / Upper Division Clerk / Stenographer in Level 4 of the Pay Matrix.
  • Minimum basic pay: ₹25,500 per month.
  • Additional allowances: Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), and Transport Allowance as per extant Central Government rules.
  • Employees will be governed by the New Pension Scheme.
  • Other benefits: medical facilities for self and dependents, subsidised canteen, limited quarters facility (in lieu of HRA), Leave Travel Concession, Group Insurance, and House Building Advance, as admissible per Central Government orders.
Component Details
Pay Level Level 4 of Pay Matrix
Minimum Basic Pay ₹25,500 per month
Allowances DA, HRA, Transport Allowance
Pension New Pension Scheme
Other Benefits Medical facilities, subsidised canteen, limited quarters (in lieu of HRA), LTC, Group Insurance, House Building Advance

Important Instructions

  • Candidates employed under Central/State Government, PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of the Skill Test. Failure to submit the original NOC will result in the candidate not being permitted to appear for the Skill Test, and TA will not be paid.
  • PwBD candidates applying for reserved posts must submit a self-attested Disability Certificate in the prescribed format, indicating percentage of disability (minimum 40% relevant disability required for reservation eligibility), issued by a duly constituted Medical Board.
  • OBC candidates must possess a valid OBC certificate (non-creamy layer, in the prescribed proforma) as on the last date of application. EWS candidates must possess a valid Income and Asset Certificate for financial year 2026–2027.
  • Candidates attending the Skill Test will be reimbursed second-class railway fare (to and fro, shortest route) from the city indicated in the application to the Skill Test venue. No TA is payable for the Written Test.
  • All original documents must be produced at the time of the Skill Test in support of details furnished online. False information will result in disqualification from the Skill Test, and TA will not be paid.
  • Answer keys will be published on the ISRO website within three working days of the written test. Objections, with valid justification, may be raised only through the designated link within 5 days of publication; objections received after this window or through any other mode will not be considered.
  • Appointees are liable to be posted or transferred to any Centre/Unit of the Department of Space/ISRO at any time, based on requirement. The number of vacancies indicated is provisional, and ISRO reserves the right to increase, decrease, or not fill the posts without assigning any reason. The posts are temporary but likely to continue.
  • Any court case or legal matter arising from this recruitment falls under Bangalore, Karnataka jurisdiction. Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification.
  • Candidates are advised NOT to take cognizance of any fake offer of appointment for jobs in ISRO.
  • In case of ambiguity between the Hindi and English versions of the notification, the English version shall be treated as final.

Chittaranjan Locomotive Works (CLW), a unit of Indian Railways, has released Employment Notice No. GMA/Rectt.&MPP/Sports Quota/2026-2027 dated 20-07-2026, inviting applications from eligible Indian National sportspersons for recruitment against Sports Quota (Open Advertisement and Talent Scouting) at CLW, Chittaranjan (West Bengal). A total of 25 vacancies are notified across Level-1, Level-2 and Level-5/4 posts, spanning 15 sports discipline/event categories including Archery, Badminton, Basketball, Football, Golf, Gymnastics, Swimming and Shooting.

Applications open on 21-07-2026 and close on 20-08-2026 (extended to 31-08-2026 for candidates from specified North-Eastern and hill states/UTs and those residing abroad). There is no online application portal - candidates must apply by post or drop their application in the Drop Box at CLW. Selection is through Sports Trial, assessment of Sports Achievements, and Educational Qualification, at CLW, Chittaranjan.

CLW Sports Quota Vacancy 2026 – Discipline-wise Details

CLW Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Applications are invited from eligible sportspersons who are Indian Nationals, for recruitment against Sports Quota (Open Advertisement and Talent Scouting) at CLW, Chittaranjan. Applicants should currently be an active player and should have fulfilled the sports achievement on or after 01-04-2024.

CLW Sports Quota Minimum Sports Norms

Level/Pay Band Grade Pay (6th CPC) Minimum Sports Norms for Recruitment

Level-2 (PB-I) Rs.1900/- Represented the country in any Category-B Championship/Event OR at least 3rd position in any Category-C Championship/Event OR at least 3rd position in Senior/Youth/Junior National Championships OR at least 3rd position in National Games (under Indian Olympic Association) OR at least 3rd position in All India Inter University Championship (Association of Indian Universities) OR 1st position in Federation Cup Championships (Senior category)

Talent Scouting Quota

Only 3 such candidates, in order of overall merit and not necessarily of any particular discipline, will be considered for recruitment. If no such candidate is found suitable, all vacancies will be filled as per the norms and procedure of Open Advertisement.

  • Basketball: Basketball Federation of India is the only recognized National Sports Federation for the game, recognized by the Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports.
  • Football (Men): The condition of mandatory quota for Under-21 players in Santosh Trophy has been excluded.
  • Golf (Men): Sportspersons with an I.G.U. ranking of 1–20, subject to a single handicap of less than 10 (in order of Merit/Amateur Merit list), are also eligible. The highest Annual All India Ranking in the year of recruitment may be considered. Selected players may play professional tournaments only after completing 5 years post-recruitment, with NOC from RSPB.
  • Rifle Shooting: Only individual performance in the recognized championships listed above will be considered. The All India G.V. Mavlankar Shooting Championship is not a recognized championship for this purpose.

CLW Sports Quota Qualification

Candidates must possess the following educational qualifications as on the date of closure of the application:

Level (7th CPC) & Grade Pay (6th CPC) Educational Qualification
Level-5/4 (Rs.2800/- & Rs.2400/-) Graduate in any discipline from a recognized University
Level-2 (Rs.1900/-) Higher Secondary (12th) or 10+2 passed or equivalent examination from a Recognized Institution, OR Matriculation from a recognized board plus Course Completed Act Apprenticeship, OR Matriculation plus Diploma approved by a recognized institution
Level-1 (Rs.1800/-) Secondary (10th) or equivalent examination, or ITI, or National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by NCVT, from a recognized institution

Candidates appointed to Junior/Senior Clerk-cum-Typist posts must qualify a Typing Proficiency Test (30 w.p.m. in English or 25 w.p.m. in Hindi) within 4 years of appointment. Candidates with higher qualifications must produce the relevant original certificate at the time of Sports Trial; candidates awaiting final examination results of the prescribed qualification are not eligible and need not apply.

CLW Sports Quota Age Limit

The candidate should have a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 25 years of age as on 01-01-2026. Matriculation or an equivalent certificate from a recognized board must be submitted as date-of-birth proof. No age relaxation is allowed, even for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates.

Category Fee

CLW Sports Quota Selection Process

Selection is based on performance in Sports Trials, Educational Qualification and Sports Achievements, assessed and finalized by a nominated Selection Committee. Sports achievements of the current and previous 2 years (2024-2025, 2025-2026 & 2026-2027) are considered as per Para 4.2 of RBE No.189(B)/2010; only achievements on or after 01-04-2024 are counted, based on the concluding day of the championship. In the event that suitable candidates with the required sports achievements are not available for Level-5 posts as notified, candidates may also be considered in lower Group C categories to the extent of the notified posts, subject to overall suitability in the discipline.

The venue and date of Trials and Interview/Certificate Verification will be intimated to eligible candidates; candidates are advised to check the CLW official website regularly. Shortlisted eligible candidates will be called for:

  • Trial of Sports Achievements - 40 marks (minimum 25 must be secured to be declared "FIT")
  • Assessment of Sports Achievements, etc. - 50 marks maximum
  • Educational Qualification - 10 marks

Minimum aggregate marks required (including a minimum of 25 marks in Trial) are 70 for Level-5/4, 65 for Level-2, and 60 for Level-1 posts, as per RBE No.141/2018. There is no relaxation or reservation of any kind for any community - selection is purely merit-based on the performances described above.

How to Apply for CLW Sports Quota Recruitment 2026

CLW Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 does not use an online application portal. Eligible candidates must apply offline as follows:

  1. Fill the application in the prescribed format (Annexure 'A'), along with other relevant annexures, on good-quality A4-size white paper, after carefully reading the Employment Notice.
  2. Fill all columns of the application in your own handwriting, in English or Hindi, using a blue or black ball-point pen.
  3. Write the sample declaration statement in your own handwriting in the space provided; applications without the written declaration will be rejected.
  4. Affix one recent (taken within one month) colour passport-size photograph with a white background, without a cap or coloured glasses; send 2 signed photographs with the application and keep at least 5 more for future use.
  5. Enclose legible photocopies of all certificates - Educational Qualification, Age, Caste Certificate, and Sports Achievement certificates - attested by a Gazetted Officer or self-attested.
  6. Enclose the applicable application fee; applications without the fee or with incomplete columns will be rejected.
  7. Clearly indicate the Specific Category No., Sports Discipline and Event/Position as given in the vacancy table.
  8. Write on the top of the envelope: "APPLICATION AGAINST SPORTS QUOTA (OPEN ADVERTISEMENT & TALENT SCOUTING) RECRUITMENT FOR THE YEAR 2026-2027."
  9. Send the application by post, or drop it in the Drop Box at the Dy.GM's Office/CLW, so that it reaches the address below on or before the closing date and time. Railway Administration is not responsible for postal delay; late applications will be summarily rejected.
  10. Serving Government employees should send their applications through proper channel, i.e., through their office.

Postal Address: Chief Personnel Officer, Administrative Building, Chittaranjan Locomotive Works, P.O. Chittaranjan, District-Paschim Bardhaman, West Bengal, Pin Code-713331.

Candidates may download the recruitment notification and application form from the CLW website: www.clw.indianrailways.gov.in.

CLW Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Eligible applicants will be issued Call Letters through the website, email and the mobile number provided, within 20 days from the closing date; candidates must report with the Call Letter.
  • SC/ST candidates are eligible for free rail travel in Second Class for attending the Sports Trial/Interview.
  • Selected candidates must pass the requisite medical fitness standard prior to appointment.
  • Candidates appointed as Junior Clerk-cum-Typist (Group C) must acquire typing proficiency of 30 w.p.m. in English or 25 w.p.m. in Hindi within 4 years of appointment; until then, the appointment remains provisional.
  • The decision of CLW Administration in all matters relating to this recruitment is final.
  • The list of applications rejected will be published on www.clw.indianrailways.gov.in; no other rejection intimation will be sent.
  • The recruitment process is purely merit-based; canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • CLW, Chittaranjan, reserves the right to cancel or modify the recruitment process at any time, without assigning reasons.
  • The date, time and venue of the Sports Trial will be fixed by the Railway Administration and intimated on the CLW official website; the administration is not responsible for late or non-receipt of intimation. Candidates should report for the Trial on the date mentioned on the website, even if the call letter is not received.
  • Applications may be treated as invalid for reasons including: receipt after the closing date/time; incorrect or incomplete format; lack of required qualifications on the date of applying; being underage/overage as stipulated; multiple applications by the same candidate; missing photo, declaration, or signature; missing enclosures; being on a debarred list; or submitting participation/medal certificates on letterheads (which are not considered).
  • CLW has not appointed any agents or coaching centres to act on its behalf for this recruitment; candidates should report any false claims by unscrupulous persons/agencies to the Chief Personnel Officer or the SDGM & Chief Vigilance Officer, CLW.
  • Any dispute regarding this recruitment is subject to the jurisdiction of the High Court of Calcutta.

Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released on 29 July 2026 on the official website of Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL). HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Candidates possessing Part Time/Correspondence/E-learning/Distance Education courses are not eligible to apply. Only Full Time/Regular Courses will be considered.
  • Candidates possessing a Diploma along with an Engineering Degree in the notified discipline must enter the marks of the Engineering Degree as qualifying marks in the online application.
  • Candidates possessing a 5-year Integrated Degree in the notified discipline/branch of Engineering are also eligible to apply.
  • Candidates currently in the Final Year/Final Semester of their Bachelor's Degree may also apply, subject to having secured the prescribed aggregate percentage up to the last semester/year at the time of applying; selection will be further subject to obtaining the minimum prescribed aggregate in the final degree, with documentary proof required at the time of Interview (tentatively scheduled for September 2026).

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

  • Upper age limit: candidates should not be above 28 years as on 14-08-2026 for UR & EWS category.

  • Upper age limit relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST candidates.
  • Upper age limit relaxable by 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates.
  • Upper age limit relaxable by 10 years for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs), over and above relaxation admissible for SC/ST/OBC(NCL) categories.
  • Upper age limit relaxable by 5 years for candidates domiciled in Jammu & Kashmir during 01-01-1980 to 31-12-1989.
  • Upper age limit relaxable up to a maximum of 5 years for Ex-Servicemen/Commissioned Officers/Emergency Commissioned Officers/Short Service Commissioned Officers with at least 5 years of Military Service, subject to other prescribed conditions.
  • Age after all applicable relaxations should not exceed 56 years for PwBDs and 55 years for other candidates.

Also Read: NICL Assistant Recruitment 2026: Apply Online for 500 Vacancies

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Reservation of Vacancies

  • Reservation for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS categories will be as per prevalent Government directives.
  • OBC candidates belonging to Creamy Layer are not entitled to relaxation under OBC(NCL) category and must indicate their category as UR in the online application.
  • The candidate's caste/community name must appear in the Central List of Other Backward Classes; a Central OBC(NCL) Certificate not older than 6 months as on 14-08-2026 must be furnished at the time of Interview, if called for.
  • Reservation of vacancies for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs) will be distributed among all categories (SC, ST, OBC-NCL, EWS & UR). PwBDs with not less than 40% of the identified disability shall be eligible for the benefit of reservation.
  • 3 vacancies are earmarked for PwBDs under Design Trainee (all disciplines), and 2 vacancies under Management Trainee (across Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Computer Science, Metallurgy, Production, and Civil disciplines), covering identified disability categories including Hearing Impairment, Locomotor Disability, Autism Spectrum Disorder (Mild), Specific Learning Disability, and Multiple Disabilities, as detailed in the official notification.

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

  • Application fee: ₹500 (inclusive of GST)
  • Candidates belonging to SC/ST/PwBD/Internal candidates are exempted from payment of application fee.
  • Application fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.
  • HAL will not be responsible if a candidate deposits the fee to the wrong account or makes multiple payments.
  • Mode of payment: Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI through the SBIePAY payment gateway (for UR/OBC(NCL)/EWS categories only). Applicable convenience fee and taxes, if any, over and above the application fee will be borne by the candidate.

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • Selection comprises an Online Computer Based Selection Test (All-India basis) followed by a Personal Interview at Bengaluru.
  • The test will be of 2.5 hours duration, comprising Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs) in three parts: Part I - 20 MCQs on General Awareness; Part II - 40 MCQs on English & Reasoning; Part III - 100 MCQs on the concerned discipline.
  • The test can be taken in Hindi or English, as per the candidate's choice indicated at the time of applying (cannot be changed later).
  • Candidates will be shortlisted for interview based on Online Test marks, in the ratio of 1:5 to the number of vacancies in each discipline and category.
  • The Final Merit List will be prepared with a weightage of 85% for the Online Test and 15% for the Interview.
  • Candidates must secure at least 50% marks each in the Written Test and Interview to qualify for selection (relaxation for reserved categories as per rules).
  • Candidates must produce an original Identity Card (Voter ID/Driving License/Aadhaar/Passport/PAN/Government or PSU-issued ID/College ID) before the Invigilator to appear for the Online Test.

How to Apply for HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026?

  1. Before registering, candidates should have ready: a valid, active e-mail ID; a soft copy passport-size colour photograph (.jpg, under 180 KB); Aadhaar Number and Mobile Number; educational details (semester-wise marks); and employment details (if applicable).
  2. Visit the HAL website www.hal-india.co.in (Careers Section) and click on the link "SELECTION OF DESIGN TRAINEE/MANAGEMENT TRAINEE - 2026," then select the post applied for.
  3. Enter and re-enter a valid e-mail ID for OTP-based registration.
  4. Fill up Eligibility Details and upload the photograph. A unique Application Number will be generated (Eligibility Details cannot be edited once submitted).
  5. Fill up Personal & Qualification Details, with an "Edit" option provided before final submission.
  6. SC/ST/PwBD/Internal candidates: registration is completed upon submission, and an Application Confirmation page is generated.
  7. UR/OBC(NCL)/EWS candidates: will be directed to the Payment Gateway to pay the application fee of ₹500 (inclusive of GST) via Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI.
  8. After successful payment, candidates will be redirected to the Application Confirmation Page - print and retain this for future reference.
  9. Complete the process well before the last date (14-08-2026, 1400 hrs) to avoid last-minute website traffic issues. Non-payment of fee or incomplete steps will render the application incomplete and it will be rejected.
  10. Note: Applying for more than one post (e.g., MT Mechanical and DT Mechanical) will lead to rejection of candidature, and any application fee paid will be forfeited.

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Placement & Emoluments

  • Selected candidates will be posted at any of HAL's Production, Overhaul, or Service Divisions/Research & Design Centres/Offices, based on Company requirements.
  • Training programme duration: 52 weeks, comprising theoretical and On-the-Job training at various locations.
  • During training, Trainees will draw a stipend comprising Basic Pay of ₹50,000, plus Variable Dearness Allowance and Canteen Allowance. Bachelor Accommodation is also admissible during training, as per Company Rules.
  • On successful completion of training, Trainees will be absorbed as Engineers in the Grade-II Scale of Pay of ₹50,000 - ₹1,60,000, with eligibility for Basic Pay, Variable Dearness Allowance, other Perks & Allowances under the Cafeteria system, Company Accommodation/HRA, Performance Related Pay, Medical Facilities, Provident Fund, Gratuity, and other superannuation benefits as per Company Rules.

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Service Agreement Bond

  • Selected candidates must execute a Service Agreement Bond to serve HAL for a period of 5 years (excluding the training period).
  • In case of breach of the Service Agreement (during training or after absorption as Engineer), the candidate is liable to reimburse actual training expenses (including recruitment expenses and all remuneration/expenses incurred during training), subject to a maximum of ₹15,00,000 (Rupees Fifteen Lakhs only).

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Pre-Employment Medical Standards

  • Candidates provisionally selected, including PwBDs, must undergo a Pre-employment Medical Examination before joining HAL.
  • Candidates must have sound health and meet the medical standards prescribed by the Company; appointment is subject to a satisfactory medical report. The decision of the Company's Doctor in this regard is final and binding, and no relaxation in health standards will be allowed.
  • For PwBDs, suitability for appointment will be decided based on Reports of the Medical Board attached to the Special Employment Exchanges for Physically Handicapped; their appointment will remain provisional until Disability Certificate verification is completed.

HAL Design Trainee/Management Trainee Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates employed in Government/Semi-Government/PSU/Quasi-Government/Autonomous Bodies (including on contract basis) must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of Interview, failing which they will not be permitted to appear and will not be eligible for Travelling Allowance.
  • Category (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/EWS/UR) once filled in the online application cannot be changed later, and no benefit of another category will be admissible subsequently.
  • Candidates under reserved categories must submit Caste/Income & Asset/Disability Certificate in the prescribed Central Government format at the time of Interview (tentatively scheduled during September 2026 at Bengaluru).
  • Appointment of selected candidates is subject to verification of Caste/Income & Asset/Disability Certificate and Character & Antecedents from concerned authorities.
  • Internal Candidates of HAL must also apply online and refer to the internal Circular dated 29-07-2026 before filling the application.
  • Mere submission of application does not entail any right to appointment or to appear in different stages of the selection process; HAL's decision in this regard shall be final.
  • There will be no separate communication to candidates regarding non-selection at any stage.
  • HAL reserves the right to cancel/restrict/increase/modify/alter the advertisement or recruitment process, and the number of vacancies notified may be increased/decreased/cancelled at the Company's discretion, without assigning reasons.
  • If information furnished by a candidate is found false, incomplete, suppressed, or not in conformity with eligibility criteria, the candidature/appointment will be revoked/terminated at any stage, without reference to the candidate.
  • Induction Training for DTs/MTs is tentatively scheduled to commence end of October 2026 at Bengaluru.

📄 Complete Details & Notification

Airports Authority of India (AAI), Regional Headquarters, Western Region, Mumbai has released the notification for engagement of Graduate and Diploma Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961/2014/2025 for the training year 2026-27. The recruitment is being conducted through Advertisement No. 03/08/2026/APPRENTICE (Graduate/Diploma)/WR.

AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 invites applications from eligible Degree and Diploma holders for apprenticeship training at various airports under the Western Region. Candidates belonging to Maharashtra, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh and the Union Territory of Diu who reside near the listed airport locations are eligible to apply.

The apprenticeship training duration is one year. Selected Graduate Apprentices will receive a stipend of ₹15,000 per month, while Diploma Apprentices will receive ₹12,000 per month. The online application process started on 03 August 2026 and the last date to apply through the NATS portal is 30 September 2026.

  • AAI WR Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Overview

Particular Details
Recruiting Organization Airports Authority of India (AAI)
Regional Office Regional Headquarters, Western Region, Mumbai
Advertisement Number 03/08/2026/APPRENTICE (Graduate/Diploma)/WR
Recruitment Name AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026
Post Name Graduate Apprentice and Diploma Apprentice
Training Duration 1 Year
Application Mode Online through NATS Portal
Eligible States/UT Maharashtra, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh and UT of Diu
Job/Training Location AAI Airports under Western Region
Stipend ₹12,000 – ₹15,000 per month
Application Fee No Application Fee
Official Portal NATS Portal

AAI Apprentice Vacancy 2026

AAI has announced Graduate and Diploma Apprentice positions in various disciplines including Finance, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunication, Information Technology, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering and Human Resources.

The number of vacancies mentioned in the notification is tentative and may be reduced or increased according to organisational requirements.

AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Event Date
Online Application Start Date 03 August 2026
Last Date to Apply Online 30 September 2026
Application Mode NATS Portal

AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Apply Online

Interested candidates are required to register themselves on the NATS 2.0 portal before applying for AAI apprenticeship training. Only applications received through the NATS portal will be considered.

Candidates must complete registration, verify their profile through the BOAT portal and apply against the AAI advertisement available on the portal dashboard.

AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates applying for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the prescribed educational qualification, age limit and other eligibility conditions mentioned in the official notification. The recruitment is open for Degree and Diploma holders in various disciplines.

Candidates must be domiciles of Maharashtra, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh or the Union Territory of Diu and should reside near the respective airport locations listed under Airports Authority of India Western Region.

AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Qualification

The educational qualification requirement differs according to the Graduate Apprentice and Diploma Apprentice discipline.

AAI Graduate Apprentice Qualification 2026

Discipline Educational Qualification
Graduate Apprentice (Finance) Degree in Commerce (B.Com) or Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration (BBA).
Graduate Apprentice (Electrical) Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Technology in Electrical Engineering from a recognised institution.
Graduate Apprentice (Civil) Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Technology in Civil Engineering from a recognised institution.
Graduate Apprentice (Electronic Communication / Tele Communication) Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/Technology in Electronic Communication or Tele Communication.
Graduate Apprentice (Information Technology / Computer Science) Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or Information Technology.
Graduate Apprentice (Mechanical Engineering) Degree in Engineering or Technology in Mechanical/Automobile Engineering from a statutory university or recognised institution.
Graduate Apprentice (HR) Degree in any stream with knowledge of computer and administrative work.

AAI Diploma Apprentice Qualification 2026

Discipline Educational Qualification
Diploma Apprentice (Electrical) Diploma in Electrical Engineering.
Diploma Apprentice (Civil) Diploma in Civil Engineering.
Diploma Apprentice (Mechanical Engineering) Diploma in Engineering/Technology in Mechanical or Automobile Engineering from a recognised institution.

AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Educational Qualification Conditions

  • Degree/Diploma candidates should possess a full-time regular four-year Degree in Engineering or a full-time regular three-year Diploma in the relevant discipline from an AICTE-recognised institution.
  • Candidates must have secured minimum 50% marks in aggregate. For SC/ST candidates, the minimum required marks are 45%.
  • Candidates who have passed Degree/Diploma on or after 01 April 2022 are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates who have completed more than five years from the date of passing the qualifying examination as on the joining date will not be eligible.
  • Candidates appearing in the final year examination and awaiting results may also apply, subject to fulfilling the required qualification at the time of joining.

AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

The age limit for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is calculated as on 31 July 2026.

Category Age Limit
Minimum Age 18 Years
Maximum Age 26 Years
SC/ST Candidates 5 Years Relaxation
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) Candidates 3 Years Relaxation

AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Stipend

Selected apprentices under AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will receive a monthly stipend during the one-year apprenticeship training period.

Apprentice Type Monthly Stipend Breakup
Graduate Apprentice ₹15,000 ₹8,850 from Establishment + ₹6,150 Government share through DBT from BOAT
Diploma Apprentice ₹12,000 ₹6,550 from Establishment + ₹5,450 Government share through DBT from BOAT

AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 will be based on the percentage of marks obtained by candidates in their qualifying examination.

Selection Stages

  1. Shortlisting of candidates based on percentage of marks in the qualifying examination.
  2. Interview and verification of certificates/testimonials.
  3. Submission of Certificate of Medical Fitness from a Gazetted Government Medical Officer or Medical Officer of a Government Undertaking at the time of joining.
  4. Police verification certificate from the local area of residence.

Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview/document verification through their registered email ID only.

AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Important Conditions

  • Apprentices must undergo training at the notified airports/establishments. Requests for change in training location will not be accepted.
  • Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship, terminated apprenticeship midway, or are currently undergoing apprenticeship with another organisation or AAI at the same qualification level are not eligible.
  • Candidates having one year or more training/job experience after attaining the essential qualification are not eligible for apprenticeship.
  • AAI will not provide any regular employment guarantee after completion of apprenticeship training.

How to Apply for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates can apply for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 through the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS 2.0) portal. Candidates must complete registration on the NATS portal before applying for apprenticeship training under Airports Authority of India, Western Region.

Steps to Apply Online for AAI Apprentice Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official NATS 2.0 portal and complete student registration.
  2. Complete the enrollment process as a Student/Apprentice on the portal.
  3. After registration, verify the profile through the BOAT portal.
  4. Login to the NATS portal and search for the AAI apprenticeship advertisement displayed on the dashboard.
  5. Apply for Airports Authority of India, Regional Headquarters, Western Region, Mumbai under the desired trade/discipline.
  6. Upload required documents and submit the application through the NATS portal.
  7. Keep a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

Sarkari Bharat Vacancies by Sector

Sarkari bharat vacancies span several major recruiting sectors. Each sector below links to a dedicated hub page with sector-specific notifications, eligibility criteria, and exam patterns.

Banking Jobs (IBPS, SBI, RBI)

Banking recruitment includes IBPS PO, IBPS Clerk, SBI PO, SBI Clerk, RBI Assistant, and NABARD postings. These roles are among the most competitive sarkari bharat jobs, offering strong starting pay and clear promotion tracks. Browse current openings on our Banking Jobs hub.

Railway Jobs (RRB NTPC, ALP, Group D)

Indian Railways is the country's largest single recruiter, with RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP, JE, and Technician posts opening in large batches. Check live Railway vacancies on our Railway Jobs hub.

Defence Jobs (Army, Navy, Air Force)

Defence recruitment covers Indian Army (including Agniveer), Navy, Air Force, BSF, CRPF, CISF, and ITBP postings. See ongoing openings on our Defence Jobs hub.

Teaching Jobs (KVS, NVS, State Boards)

Teaching sarkari jobs include KVS, NVS, DSSSB, and state education board recruitment for TGT, PGT, and PRT posts. Explore current teaching vacancies on our Teaching Jobs hub.

SSC & UPSC Notifications

SSC (CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD) and UPSC (Civil Services, CDS, NDA) notifications remain the most closely tracked central-government exams. Full notification archives are available on our SSC Jobs and UPSC Jobs hubs.

Not every sarkari job requires a degree. Use the qualification and state filters below to sarkari job find openings that actually match your eligibility, instead of scrolling through listings you don't qualify for.

Several high-volume recruiters - including Railways (Group D), SSC (MTS, GD), and state police departments - recruit primarily at the 10th pass and 12th pass level. Browse these openings on our 10th & 12th Pass Jobs page.

Sarkari Job for Graduates & Postgraduates

Graduate and postgraduate-level sarkari jobs include SSC CGL, Bank PO, UPSC Civil Services, and various state PCS exams. See qualification-matched listings on our Graduate Jobs page.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 कैसे भरें? (How to Apply Online)

हर साल लाखों उम्मीदवार सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 भरने की प्रक्रिया में गलतियाँ कर बैठते हैं, जिससे उनका आवेदन रद्द हो सकता है। नीचे दी गई सरल प्रक्रिया से आप अपना फॉर्म सही तरीके से भर सकते हैं।

आवेदन की चरणबद्ध प्रक्रिया

  1. संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना (Notification PDF) ध्यान से पढ़ें और अपनी पात्रता जांचें।
  2. वैध ईमेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर से पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण (Registration) करें।
  3. व्यक्तिगत विवरण, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, और आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें (फोटो, हस्ताक्षर, प्रमाणपत्र)।
  4. निर्धारित आवेदन शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें और भुगतान की रसीद सुरक्षित रखें।
  5. फॉर्म सबमिट करने से पहले सभी जानकारी की दोबारा जांच करें और फॉर्म का प्रिंटआउट अवश्य लें।

Documents Required for Sarkari Form

Typical documents needed: recent passport-size photograph (as per specified size/format), scanned signature, educational certificates and mark sheets, category certificate (if applicable), and a valid ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN).

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

  • Submitting a photo or signature that doesn't match the specified pixel/size requirements.
  • Missing the last date due to server load - apply at least 2–3 days before deadline.
  • Entering a name or date of birth that doesn't match your certificates exactly.
  • Forgetting to download and save the final submitted form and payment receipt.

A Bharat Sarkari Job refers to any government job opportunity across India's central and state departments - including Railways, Banking, SSC, UPSC, Defence, Police, and PSUs - offering job security, fixed pay scales, and pension benefits under government service rules.

How do I find a Sarkari Job that matches my qualification?

Use the qualification filters on this page to sarkari job find openings suited to 10th pass, 12th pass, diploma, graduate, or postgraduate candidates, sorted by sector and state.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 में आवेदन कैसे करें?

सबसे पहले संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना पढ़ें, पात्रता जांचें, फिर वैध ईमेल और मोबाइल नंबर से रजिस्ट्रेशन करके फॉर्म भरें, दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें और आवेदन शुल्क जमा करें।

Is OnlyJobs reliable for sarkarijob updates?

Yes - OnlyJobs has tracked sarkarijob notifications since 2011, cross-verifying every listing against official department websites before publishing.

What is the difference between a Sarkari Job and a private-sector job?

Sarkari jobs offer government-backed job security, pension (NPS/OPS), fixed working hours, and statutory benefits, while private jobs typically offer market-driven pay with fewer long-term security guarantees.
